ribbons.text: I walked my round that night. Same as any night.
ribbons.press_text: 'Needle Lane, Cutter's Row, back along the wall. Forty-one lamps. I have walked it eleven years.'

ribbons.text: The Chandlers had no business on my streets.
ribbons.press_text: 'Their wax, their carts, their little sealed dockets. Business, they call it. We call it Tuesday.'

ribbons.text: Every lamp on the lane was burning when I left it.
ribbons.press_text: 'Burning. I do not leave a lamp guttering. Ask anyone. Ask the lamps.'

ribbons.text: And it was signed for, same as any round.
ribbons.press_text: 'Signed and countersigned. The Chandlers pay for the oil, so the Chandlers get their signature.'
ribbons.break_text: Merrow goes still. 'That is Wick's hand. And that is the night nobody signed.' She fetches the tally without being asked.
ribbons.rebuff_text: 'That proves nothing about my round, cat.'

when_outcome.success: The thread that would not hold, caught. Merrow respects it, which is worse than liking it.
when_outcome.partial: Merrow stops talking. Not angry — done. The lane will be colder next time.
when_outcome.walk_away: Ash lets it lie. The Lamplighters keep their tally and their opinions.
